name: 46310 · Demotte, IN
findings: ZIP 46310 (Demotte) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46310 (Demotte) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
56% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
